articles.title: How to make a quotation or estimate
articles.summary: Make a quotation or an estimate in the free Nivesh Sahayak maker: customer, validity, items, show GST or not, terms, then share the PDF on WhatsApp.

articles.title: Turn a quotation into an invoice
articles.card: Quotation to invoice in one click
articles.summary: Convert an accepted quotation into a GST invoice with Make invoice in Nivesh Sahayak, or into a sales order or challan from the App, without typing again.

articles.title: How quotation numbers work
articles.summary: How quotation numbers work in Nivesh Sahayak: QT series per business, restart every 1 April, change the prefix, and fix a duplicate number.

articles.title: Print, PDF and share a quotation
articles.summary: Print a quotation on A4, A5 or a thermal roll, pick one of 7 designs and copies, save a PDF, or share it on WhatsApp from Nivesh Sahayak.

articles.title: Saved quotations: find, open, copy and edit
articles.summary: Find any saved quotation in Nivesh Sahayak: search the Saved quotations list, open to edit or reprint, copy it as new, set its status.
